title: Move the before-and-after slider (ui_compare) arguments
description: Move the before-and-after slider on the Look screen: reveal 0 shows only the before photo, 100 only the try-on. Use it to reveal the try-on while you describe it. Free. Needs a look presented with both a try-on image and a before photo.

reveal.description: How much of the try-on is visible, 0 to 100 percent.
